tools.name: list_servers
tools.title: List Rising World servers
tools.description: List the publicly listed Rising World servers tracked by the manager, with name, version, region and last known player counts.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter matched against server name or label.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return (default 25).

tools.name: get_server
tools.title: Get server details
tools.description: Get the stored details of one publicly listed Rising World server by its manager id, or by a name/label match.

server.description: Server id, or part of the server name/label.

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.title: Get live server status
tools.description: Get the live status of a publicly listed Rising World server: online/offline, player count and the current online player list.

serverId.description: Manager id of the server (from list_servers).

tools.name: get_server_statistics
tools.title: Get server statistics
tools.description: Get hourly player-count and availability statistics for one publicly listed Rising World server.

serverId.description: Manager id of the server (from list_servers).

from.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp of the range.

to.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp of the range.

tools.name: get_global_statistics
tools.title: Get network statistics
tools.description: Get aggregated hourly statistics across all publicly listed Rising World servers tracked by the manager.

from.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp of the range.

to.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp of the range.
